andrewcraddock1980: Henrik "Ghost" Andrewcraddo came up with a draft of replacements on Day 10. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
A supply man offered Henrik "Ghost" Andrewcraddo a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.
big_hoodie_kid: Clement "Spark" Kid unpacked a rosary of rough beads at S-S9. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
Clement "Spark" Kid kept watch so that Emil Majormalprac could sleep. Then Emil kept watch so that Spark could. Neither slept.
Clement "Spark" Kid remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.
Clement "Spark" Kid spent the afternoon delousing his shirt over a candle. The lice won on points.
Clement "Spark" Kid won his boots at cards from a lance corporal in S-S9. The lance corporal wants a rematch.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Clement "Spark" Kid kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

A bullet clipped Clement "Spark" Kid's helmet at S-S9 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Severin Heheheha of the Hegemony (@heheheha1939). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Clement "Spark" Kid is number 384. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech.
cbeattie.1770: Casimir Cbeattie introduced himself as a railway porter from Ashford Vale. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.

Casimir Cbeattie studied the trench map until the candle died, then walked S-F19 in the dark to learn it by heart. A letter from home reached Casimir Cbeattie before dusk. Casimir Cbeattie read it twice and slept a little easier.

A shell burst over S-F19 and threw Casimir Cbeattie into the side of the trench. Cuts, bruises, ringing ears. He stayed at his post. A letter from home reached Casimir Cbeattie before dusk. Casimir Cbeattie read it twice and slept a little easier. Victory at Hill 304. Casimir Cbeattie let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Casimir Cbeattie wore a fresh bandage at S-F19 and was told to rest. He rested for about an hour. A letter from home reached Casimir Cbeattie before dusk. Casimir Cbeattie read it twice and slept a little easier.

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Casimir Cbeattie is whole again, or near enough for the line. A letter from home reached Casimir Cbeattie before dusk. Casimir Cbeattie read it twice and slept a little easier.

Casimir Cbeattie and Florian "Button" Thebaileebla carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident. A letter from home reached Casimir Cbeattie before dusk. Casimir Cbeattie read it twice and slept a little easier.

Casimir Cbeattie heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously. A letter from home reached Casimir Cbeattie before dusk. Casimir Cbeattie read it twice and slept a little easier.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Casimir Cbeattie was hit hard in the fight at S-F19 before anyone could fire. The raider was Silas Michigangame of the Concord. Raider: Silas Michigangame of the Concord (@michigangamer). On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Casimir Cbeattie wrote the name in his diary with unusual care. A letter from home reached Casimir Cbeattie before dusk. Casimir Cbeattie read it twice and slept a little easier.

Casimir Cbeattie rejoined the squad at S-F19. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there. The clerk counted the names twice. Casimir Cbeattie is number 269 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand.
dominickthebombinick25: The old hands of S-C6 have been here since Day 1. Gideon Dominicktheb has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

A bullet clipped Gideon Dominicktheb's helmet at S-C6 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Florian Team of the Hegemony (@phs_jrotc_drill_team). Gideon Dominicktheb fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Yann "Whistle" Inexactjupit was badly wounded. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Gideon Dominicktheb watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Gideon Dominicktheb returned to S-C6 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Gideon Dominicktheb is number 672. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech.
emperornoblez: Zeno Emperornoble came from Halden, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Zeno Emperornoble lent Otto "Parson" Vicious a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.
The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Zeno Emperornoble offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once.
Zeno Emperornoble fired three short bursts at nothing to keep the enemy honest. The enemy fired three back to keep him honest too.

Zeno Emperornoble swept the enemy parapet at S-S5 with one long burst. Dust jumped all along the sandbags. Dorian "Ash" Juanito was grazed. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Zeno Emperornoble watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Zeno Emperornoble put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Zeno Emperornoble is number 464. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech.
huntertheyankee: Pavel Huntertheyan told the sergeant he was a medical student. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Pavel Huntertheyan wrote to twin brothers too young to enlist that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Wendel "Ash" Theexpendabl and Pavel Huntertheyan both swear they saw a ghost at the Hanging Bridge. Each says the other screamed first.
j.t.772: Bastian Jt came from Greyhallow, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.

Bastian Jt of the Hegemony spotted Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar of the Concord repairing a parapet at Hill 304. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot. Day 6. The Hegemony took Hill 304. From the heights Bastian Jt could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Bastian Jt's bunk. He has named it Duchess.
Duchess the rat now waits for Bastian Jt at dawn watch every morning. He shares crumbs with it. The corporal calls this desertion of rations.
Duchess ran squealing out of the dugout at three in the morning. Bastian Jt followed, cursing, seconds before a shell came through the roof. He owes Duchess his life.
Bastian Jt has not seen Duchess for two days. He tells everyone rats come and go. He still leaves crumbs on the box.
The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Bastian Jt helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Bastian Jt reached up to fix a sandbag at S-S8 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich of the Concord (@coreyjmcmichael). The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Bastian Jt answered to number 370.
jdavidfrancisco: The quartermaster asked Pavel Jdavidfranci to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included. Pavel Jdavidfranci transferred to the signallers. The men in R-C4 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-C4 with the rations. Pavel Jdavidfranci ate while listening to the revised orders. A letter from home found Pavel Jdavidfranci before the night shift. Pavel Jdavidfranci folded it small and kept it close.

A bullet found Pavel Jdavidfranci at R-C4, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Rafael "Owl" Dooley of the Hegemony (@kaelan_dooley). A letter from home found Pavel Jdavidfranci before the night shift. Pavel Jdavidfranci folded it small and kept it close. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Pavel Jdavidfranci answered to number 770.
najeb_johnson: Nobody asked Benedikt Johnson why he came. Nobody in Q-F12 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Benedikt Johnson was hit hard in the fight at Q-F12 before anyone could fire. The raider was Walter "Crow" Viti of the Hegemony. Raider: Walter "Crow" Viti of the Hegemony (@viti_w02). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Benedikt Johnson stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Benedikt Johnson's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at Q-F12 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
pablo404585: Bastian "Saint" Pablo came up on Day 9 carrying news from Lindenbruck. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Bastian "Saint" Pablo was hit in the foot through his boot at S-R12. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Henrik "Shadow" Hume of the Hegemony (@hunnnter_hume). Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Bastian "Saint" Pablo wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

The bearers moved Bastian "Saint" Pablo's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Bastian "Saint" Pablo is number 856. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech.
raptor2561: Gustav "Mud" Raptor came up on Day 3 carrying news from Halden. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired. Orders assigned Gustav "Mud" Raptor to work as a machine gunner. The first lesson began with what not to touch.
Gustav "Mud" Raptor caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either.
Dawn watch. Gustav "Mud" Raptor put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Dietrich Linningorchi, grazed.

A flare caught Gustav "Mud" Raptor halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached. A letter from home reached Gustav "Mud" Raptor before dusk. Gustav "Mud" Raptor read it twice and slept a little easier. The sergeant read out the order: Hill 304 has fallen, hold the line. Gustav "Mud" Raptor looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Gustav "Mud" Raptor had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver crossed it, Gustav "Mud" Raptor fired. Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver was grazed.

Gustav "Mud" Raptor was hit through the chest at R-F5. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Benedikt Shi of the Hegemony (@rei0_shi4). Gustav "Mud" Raptor was killed outright at R-F5, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Benedikt Shi of the Hegemony (@rei0_shi4).

Isidor "Mole" Raptor arrived carrying the family name of Gustav "Mud" Raptor. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer. The transfer made Isidor "Mole" Raptor a machine gunner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Isidor "Mole" Raptor's ear at R-F5 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Konrad Danielmcmena of the Hegemony (@danielmcmenamy). A letter from home reached Isidor "Mole" Raptor before dusk. Isidor "Mole" Raptor read it twice and slept a little easier.

Isidor "Mole" Raptor was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-F5. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Gustav Marksebastio of the Hegemony (@marksebastion).

Isidor "Mole" Raptor survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at R-F5, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post. After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Isidor "Mole" Raptor helped stack spare sandbags at R-F5. Nobody asked when they would be needed. A letter from home reached Isidor "Mole" Raptor before dusk. Isidor "Mole" Raptor read it twice and slept a little easier.

Isidor "Mole" Raptor tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived. A letter from home reached Isidor "Mole" Raptor before dusk. Isidor "Mole" Raptor read it twice and slept a little easier. The clerk counted the names twice. Isidor "Mole" Raptor is number 201 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand.
tomishidk: Quentin Tomishidk came up with a draft of replacements on Day 3. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

A pump handle snapped off in Quentin Tomishidk's hands. He fixed it while the water rose around his ankles. The transfer made Quentin Tomishidk a stretcher bearer. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.
A football came over the parapet from the Hegemony side with Dorian Coletonmarti's name scratched on it. Quentin Tomishidk kicked it back. It did not come again.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Quentin Tomishidk tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at S-F18 is up. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached S-F18 with the rations. Quentin Tomishidk ate while listening to the revised orders.

Quentin Tomishidk remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Tomishidk. Quentin Tomishidk read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Quentin Tomishidk sang under his breath on sentry. Across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Tomishidk. Quentin Tomishidk read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Quentin Tomishidk splinted a broken leg with a rifle and two belts. The patient asked if he was a real doctor. He said yes. He was lying.

Quentin Tomishidk draws portraits of the men in the margins of letters. Today, under fire at the Brickworks, that habit was the only steady thing in S-F18. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Tomishidk. Quentin Tomishidk read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Quentin Tomishidk threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Nils Hellcat was down and screaming for a medic. (@hellcat34106) The Hegemony sentry, Cyril Miller, shouted once. Quentin Tomishidk silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@ryder_miller11) The Hegemony raiders came over at S-F18 in the middle of the night. Quentin Tomishidk met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Walter Juizy of the Hegemony (@juizy_44).

Leopold Tomishidk had heard about Quentin Tomishidk's courage. At S-F18, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting. Now serving as a stretcher bearer, Leopold Tomishidk discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.

A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Leopold Tomishidk worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold Tomishidk. Leopold Tomishidk read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Leopold Tomishidk got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 215. The men who came later will ask about it.
vincent.correaa: Dietrich "Brick" Correaa reported to T-F8 with his mother's thimble sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Wendel "Shadow" Warren cut Dietrich "Brick" Correaa's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.
